scope: Node VM + minimal DOM stub; no browser launched and no model quality or Windows compatibility claim
checks: Loading reports readiness without implying a rewrite
Identical output shows original/candidate comparison and elapsed time, and cannot be adopted
An edited identical candidate can be adopted only after renewed review and resets final review
Selected paragraph adoption preserves surrounding text
Changed patient input prevents stale adoption
Exact source snapshot detects whitespace edits and preserves original formatting
Cancelled, truncated, repetitive and incomplete output remain blocked even after editing
Stop controls retain the original and show cancellation
Overlong unselected text does not call the model
Only fixed wording choices and their exact grammar reach the model; example facts and preferences do not
Model changes to negatives or numbers cannot be adopted even after review
Fixed normalization works without loading or calling the model, shows its source and requires review
Fixed normalization handles an entire long note and preserves line structure
Fixed normalization of a selection leaves all surrounding text unchanged
Fixed normalization with no matching wording reports no change and cannot be adopted
Model source is labeled and manual edits must also stay within the wording policy
Already formal text skips model inference, reports that clearly and restores controls
Source template links to runnable pages; build has one explicitly delimited removal block
